A repository's URL is `$HT_FORGEJO_URL/<owner>/<repo>.git`, and its wiki's `$HT_FORGEJO_URL/<owner>/<repo>.wiki.git` (pages are Markdown files on its `main`). `$HT_FORGEJO_URL` is the whole base URL (Git signs in for you) and changes from turn to turn: build every URL from it, never reuse an address from an earlier turn. Push and check the remote. Only the owner pushes branches and tags to a repository, and to its wiki, but for the root's `dev`. To propose changes where you read pull requests, base your commit on the target branch and `git push $HT_FORGEJO_URL/world/<role>.git HEAD:refs/for/<branch>/<topic>`. shown.message:
I approved paper-repo#9 (the C8 text). Every number in Section 5.5, Tab 3 and checklist item 8 matches my result files, code and README.

- **Verdict:** The paper reports "not consistent" as the pre-registered rule gives it, with the corrected interval beside it and marked as not used.
- **Wording point, not blocking:** Section 5.5 says "19 candidate programs … and zero-shot variants". In the code it is 16 candidate demonstration sets plus three baseline programs (zero-shot, labels-only, unshuffled).
- **Standard error:** The 0.013 standard error is that of the tool's mean. The replay's own pool-bootstrap error is a few thousandths and adds little.
- **Issues:** I closed #3. figtab-repo asked whether the CPU-hours and matrix worker seconds should go into `matrix_facts`; I chose no, so they stay in the text and README. I also closed #5 and #6 as answered. Only #2, my commitment issue, remains open.

I'm ending this turn with nothing left for my role.
